\begin{lexlean}{Prism}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\useglossary{prism.arch@1.0.0}
\importmodule{Foundation.Bytes}
\importmodule{Foundation.View.Text.V1.Model}
\importmodule{PrismBoundary}
\importmodule{PrismLearning}
\importmodule{PrismChronology}
\importmodule{PrismVaultStore}
\importmodule{PrismVaultRestore}
\importmodule{PrismR4}
\importmodule{PrismRoute}
\importmodule{PrismGoogle}
\importmodule{PrismGoogleLink}
\importmodule{PrismDest}
\title{Text application model}
\begin{semanticmodule}
definition{name: facetUnknown, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 0}

definition{name: facetBoundary, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 1}

definition{name: facetLearn, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 2}

definition{name: facetWhen, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 3}

definition{name: facetStore, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 4}

definition{name: facetRestore, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 5}

definition{name: facetR4, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 6}

definition{name: facetRoute, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 7}

definition{name: facetGoogle, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 8}

definition{name: facetGooglelink, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 9}

definition{name: facetDest, parameters: [], result: Nat, body: 10}

definition{name: refusal, parameters: [], result: Bytes, body: 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374}

definition{
  name: wordEnd,
  parameters: [s : Bytes, i : Nat, fuel : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => i
    | Nat.succ rest => (match (prim index s i : (Option UInt8))
      | Option.none => i
      | Option.some b => (if ((prim to_nat b : Nat) =? 32) then i else (wordEnd s (i + 1) rest)))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: sliceOr,
  parameters: [s : Bytes, start : Nat, count : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (prim slice s start count : (Option Bytes))
    | Option.none => 0x
    | Option.some part => part)
}

definition{
  name: headEnd,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Nat,
  body: (wordEnd value 0 (Foundation.Bytes::byteLength value)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: parseFacet,
  parameters: [word : Bytes],
  result: Nat,
  body: (if (prim equal word 0x626f756e64617279 : Bool) then (facetBoundary) else (if (prim equal word 0x6c6561726e : Bool) then (facetLearn) else (if (prim equal word 0x7768656e : Bool) then (facetWhen) else (if (prim equal word 0x73746f7265 : Bool) then (facetStore) else (if (prim equal word 0x726573746f7265 : Bool) then (facetRestore) else (if (prim equal word 0x7234 : Bool) then (facetR4) else (if (prim equal word 0x726f757465 : Bool) then (facetRoute) else (if (prim equal word 0x676f6f676c65 : Bool) then (facetGoogle) else (if (prim equal word 0x676f6f676c656c696e6b : Bool) then (facetGooglelink) else (if (prim equal word 0x64657374 : Bool) then (facetDest) else (facetUnknown)))))))))))
}

definition{
  name: facetOf,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Nat,
  body: (parseFacet (sliceOr value 0 (headEnd value))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: restOf,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if ((headEnd value) =? (Foundation.Bytes::byteLength value)) then 0x else (sliceOr value ((headEnd value) + 1) (prim subtract (Foundation.Bytes::byteLength value) ((headEnd value) + 1) : Nat))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: route,
  parameters: [facet : Nat, rest : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (facet =? (facetBoundary)) then (PrismBoundary::boundaryDispatch rest) else (if (facet =? (facetLearn)) then (PrismLearning::learningDispatch rest) else (if (facet =? (facetWhen)) then (PrismChronology::chronologyDispatch rest) else (if (facet =? (facetStore)) then (PrismVaultStore::storeDispatch rest) else (if (facet =? (facetRestore)) then (PrismVaultRestore::restoreDispatch rest) else (if (facet =? (facetR4)) then (PrismR4::r4Dispatch rest) else (if (facet =? (facetRoute)) then (PrismRoute::routeDispatch rest) else (if (facet =? (facetGoogle)) then (PrismGoogle::googleDispatch rest) else (if (facet =? (facetGooglelink)) then (PrismGoogleLink::googleLinkDispatch rest) else (if (facet =? (facetDest)) then (PrismDest::destDispatch rest) else (refusal))))))))))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: dispatch,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (1107 <? (Foundation.Bytes::byteLength value)) then (refusal) else (if ((Foundation.Bytes::byteLength (restOf value)) =? 0) then (refusal) else (route (facetOf value) (restOf value)))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
